title: Start claude-session sub-sessions through paseo run inside Paseo
action: Outcome: inside Paseo (paseo::inside_paseo() true) a `bee herding run --session-model <m> [--session-effort <e>]` run starts the sub-session with `paseo run` (provider claude, model <m>, --thinking <e> when given, --mode bypassPermissions) through the existing execute_paseo_steered path, so it shows in the Paseo UI in the workspace resolve_paseo_workspace picks (record, ensure, or refuse with its FIX line). The Paseo --title is claude_session::session_name(cell, seat, job). The job record keeps session_model and session_effort next to transport paseo. Read-only, ceiling, mailbox result, steer_to, archive on finish/timeout come from the paseo path unchanged. Outside Paseo the claude --bg path (execute_claude_session) is byte-for-byte unchanged; unit tests see outside Paseo unless they call set_inside_paseo_for_test(true). D2: make the paseo model check accept a Claude family alias (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable, optional [..] suffix) against an observed claude-<alias>-<version> id, so a session-model run raises no model mismatch; a real different model still mismatches. Contract: no new transport, no change to paseo-agent herding behavior, no code comments.
must_haves: red-first test: inside Paseo, a session-model run calls paseo `run` with --provider claude/<m>, --thinking <e>, --mode bypassPermissions, --title bee-<cell>-<job tail>, and never calls the claude spawn
test: inside Paseo the job record carries transport paseo, session_model and session_effort
test: inside Paseo a read-only session-model run without the worker guard refuses before spawn
test: outside Paseo the existing claude-session tests still pass unchanged and no paseo call happens
test: alias opus matches observed claude-opus-5-5 and opus[1m] matches claude-opus-5-5[1m]; sonnet vs claude-opus-5-5 still mismatches
acceptance: In a Paseo session, review/advisor/hat dispatches on the claude-session channel appear as Paseo agents named bee-<cell or seat>-<job>; outside Paseo nothing changes.

deviations: sync-ack: skills/bee-herding names no claude-session or session-model transport detail; the area doc claude-session-transport.md carries it and the docs cell pvs-3 updates it
